case_info.description: Pediatric coarctation of aorta - RANS k-omega SST with fine resolution
case_info.notes: RANS turbulence model with y+ controlled boundary layers, fine mesh resolution

mesh._comment_yplus: Auto-calculates finalLayerThickness in ABSOLUTE units (meters) for y+ = 1.0

SNAPPY_SETTINGS._comment_nProc: Number of cores for mesh generation (can differ from solver)
SNAPPY_SETTINGS._comment_addLayer: Number of boundary layers (MUST use 'addLayer' not 'nSurfaceLayers')
SNAPPY_SETTINGS._comment_minThickness: Minimum absolute thickness in meters (1e-6 m = 0.001 mm)
SNAPPY_SETTINGS._comment_relativeSizes: MUST be false when using y+ calculator (finalLayerThickness is in meters)
SNAPPY_SETTINGS._comment_resolveAngle: Minimum angle to resolve features (30° recommended minimum)

physics._comment_pediatric: Pediatric blood properties - slightly lower viscosity than adult

computational._comment_usage: Max processors available for both meshing and solving

run_settings._comment_subdomains: Number of processor subdomains for parallel solving (decomposePar)
